parsed.claim: For every δ>0 the Hamming variational feasible set is nonempty, witnessed by a=1/2, b=0 (gamma = 1 > 1-2δ). So Hamming.variationalRate is a genuine infimum there, not the junk sInf ∅ = 0. This does not check the Johnson rateSet, which is the declaration the finding targets.
parsed.lean:
theorem probe_hamming_nonempty {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    (MetricCodes.Hamming.rateSet δ).Nonempty := by
  refine ⟨_, (1/2 : ℝ), 0, ⟨le_refl _, by norm_num, le_refl _, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
  have h : Real.sqrt ((1/2:ℝ) * (1 - 1/2)) = 1/2 := by
    rw [show (1/2:ℝ)*(1-1/2) = (1/2)^2 by norm_num]
    exact Real.sqrt_sq (by norm_num)
  unfold MetricCodes.hammingGamma
  rw [h]
  norm_num <;> linarith
